name: SMART Goals Framework
instructions: Make your goal Specific (exactly what), Measurable (how you'll know), Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound (by when).
Rewrite one vague goal you currently have ("get healthier") into a SMART version ("walk 20 minutes, 4 days a week, for the next month").
Break the SMART goal into weekly checkpoints so progress is visible before the final deadline.
Watch today's video for the SMART framework explained in full.
